Hymn 295: O Love That Glorifies the Son
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Crawford Gates
Lyricist/Text Author: Vilate Raile
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 295 titled "O Love That Glorifies the Son" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Crawford Gates and the lyrics were written by Vilate Raile.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
